capabilityRationales.assets.raw.v1: Expose loose runtime assets from mods_runtime for a split API v4 package.
capabilityRationales.render.meshes.v1: Bind runtime OBJ and texture assets to reusable mesh ids through v3 conventions.
capabilityRationales.actors.prefabs.v1: Allow visual components to synthesize reusable prefab bindings from mesh-backed DSL documents.
capabilityRationales.world.instances.v1: Place entity-backed props directly from mods_data/world without hard-coding prefab ids at each instance.
capabilityRationales.editor.placement.v1: Publish reusable entity-backed placement entries through the world convention root.
capabilityRationales.world.authoring.v1: Exercise authored placements through the v3 convention model and entity-driven placement bindings.
capabilityRationales.dsl.components.v1: Load generic component DSL documents from the components directory.
capabilityRationales.dsl.entities.v1: Load generic entity DSL documents from the entities directory.
capabilityRationales.dsl.graphs.v1: Load generic graph DSL documents from the graphs directory.
capabilityRationales.services.endpoints.v1: Expose service endpoint metadata for cross-mod lookup.
